ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across approximately 95% of the visible surface, with sparse high-intensity (white) linear noise and small clusters at the distal extremities.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly dark (low-intensity) base across both lobes; high-contrast white linear pixel streaks are scattered semi-randomly, with a higher density of these geometric disruptions on the right lobe medial and distal regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible U-shaped central depression with an estimated wide internal angle of approximately 115 degrees and moderate pixel depth relative to the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations with variable pixel-amplitude; most pronounced jaggedness is detected on the distal half of the right lobe trailing edge, showing irregular peak-to-valley transitions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Exhibits a generally straight trajectory from the median notch that transitions into a slight concavity toward the outer distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast clusters of circular white and tan pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized specifically at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive detection of white, non-aligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) across the entire visible ventral surface, particularly prominent on the lower half of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across both lobes and significant localized biological encrustation (barnacles) at the lateral lobe extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced jaggedness and physical irregularities on the trailing edge of the right lobe near the tip compared to the left lobe.
